verdict.rationale: Configurable name matching with alias or transliteration inspection is a fair question for an identity, KYC and AML screening platform like Alloy, so the axis applies. The pack only mentions AML checks generally and webhooks firing when a watchlist gets updated. Nothing describes configuring name-matching thresholds or logic, or viewing alias or transliteration match details, so these adjacent mentions earn no credit.
